in_InvoiceFileName.description: The invoice PDF's name in storage bucket InvoicesStorage (folder Tools), e.g. INV-22150825.pdf — the generator's out_InvoiceFileName.

out_InvoiceJSON.description: The invoice as JSON text, in the exercise's invoice shape: invoiceNumber, poNumber, invoiceDate, dueDate, currency, vendor {name, address, country, taxId}, buyer {…}, lines [{n, description, quantity, unitPrice, lineTotal}], subtotal, taxName, taxRate, taxTotal, total. Values are what IXP read from the PDF — they may contain extraction mistakes.

out_PONumber.description: The purchase-order number IXP read from the invoice (PO-<8 digits>), for the PurchaseOrders lookup.

out_InvoiceNumber.description: The invoice number IXP read from the invoice (INV-<8 digits>).
